Sets up KOs next turn.

Dragapult Shadow Ball chips Arcanine (29-57%), with a chance to KO from 51%. Dragapult outspeeds everything and moves before any foe attack. Safe pivot that maintains offensive pressure.

Switch Incineroar to Serperior to preserve Intimidate and avoid Fake Out flinch; Dragapult Protects to block the threatening Sucker Punch (63-93%) + Ice Beam (35-51%) combo that could KO it. Serperior safely absorbs Fake Out (8-21%) and even Ice Beam (21-57%) without being OHKOed, giving us a healthy Contrary sweeper next turn alongside a preserved Dragapult.

Serperior's LeafStorm is accepted; Empoleon should survive. Foe must send Dragapult (13%) next, which Grimmsnarl Sucker Punch KOs.

reflections.summary: Serperior's Contrary Leaf Storm snowballed unchecked after Dragapult eliminated Mega Gengar, the opponent's main threat. Incineroar's Intimidate cycling and Fake Out support enabled Serperior to set up and sweep.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, expect the opponent to bring Slowbro as a Serperior check and to preserve Gengar more carefully. Adjust by bringing a Pokemon that can pressure Slowbro (e.g., a strong Dark or Electric type) and consider leading with Dragapult to remove Gengar before Serperior enters, or use Taunt from Serperior to shut down Slowbro's recovery.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's lead preference: Arcanine + Empoleon. Back: Grimmsnarl + Gengar-Mega. They use Protect frequently. Grimmsnarl carries Taunt and Sucker Punch. Gengar-Mega is a major threat with Shadow Tag; must be eliminated quickly. Slowbro and Bastiodon were not brought; Slowbro could be a check to Serperior with Psyshock. Kingambit was ineffective this game; consider alternative for next game. Serperior speed 172 outspeeds Arcanine (115-147) and Empoleon (80-112). At +2 SpA, Leaf Storm OHKOs both. Arcanine Flamethrower OHKOs Serperior from 38%; Empoleon Ice Beam has ~57% chance to KO from 38%.
